auth_details: No authentication required for basic public endpoints. Optional account registration for higher rate limits and historical data access.
free_tier_limits: Free for non-commercial use; rate limits apply to anonymous and authenticated users
rate_limits: Anonymous: ~10 requests per 10 seconds; Authenticated: higher limits (see docs)
description: OpenSky Network provides free, open access to ADS-B aircraft state vectors and historical flight data for non-commercial research and applications. It aggregates real-time aircraft positions, velocities, and identities from a global network of receivers, enabling developers to track flights, analyze air traffic, and build aviation tools without commercial licensing fees.
